comment: The --blas CBLAS downcalls (.kb/linalg-blas.md), in a file of their own: rontolisp's binary
reads it beside the main one, and the JVM backend copies it verbatim into a compiled --blas
program (JvmBlasRuntimeBuilder), whose image reads only the program's own META-INF. It
therefore stands alone. Seven shapes, the same for eval/LinalgBlasKernels and the shipped
JvmBlasTemplate: gemm (14 parameters) at both widths, critical and plain -- a product above
the critical flop ceiling is issued through the plain handle -- gemv (12) at both widths,
critical, and jint(), the optional thread-count query (openblas_get_num_threads,
mkl_get_max_threads). One missing entry sends the whole binding down its catch and the
library declines as though the machine had none. LinalgBlasDeclineTest and
JvmBlasTemplateNativeImageTest pin this file against what each binding asks for.
